title: Galaxy graph (nodes with baked layout, typed edges)

layout.description: the layout method, e.g. learn-tree+ns-treemap@1 (D66); older graphs: spiral+d3-force@seed:42

ord.description: place in the system chain on the spiral (D66): even one arm, odd the other, outward

tree.description: Learn TOC tree inside the system as [parent hub id, child hub id]: the tree guides

plots.description: namespace plots as [namespace path, x, y, w, h, objects] in world units, sized by every object of the system

sysedges.description: the two heaviest cross-system pairs of each system as [system, system, weight]; Localizations and Sources left out

url.description: absent in the summary when it is the page path of the id: <type>s/<rest>/

lit_at.description: last content date; drives the newly-lit effect

ev.description: evidence on the star (Learn pages, videos and posts linked to it or naming it exactly): brightness

cv.description: objects: BC majors they changed in

ob.description: objects: BC majors in which they were marked obsolete (code timelines)

nn.description: objects: distinct objects they share a code relation with

ns.description: objects: namespace path without the vendor (Sales.Customer), the atlas's ?ns=

cross.description: cross-system edges, heaviest first: [target system, distinct targets, most frequent kind, up to 3 targets]; a target that is a summary star is its id, any other [id, label]. Objects: code relations; other stars: page links

crossMore.description: target systems beyond the 6 in cross

mb.description: media bodies: videos and posts on the star, total and the newest 6 as [id, v or p, date]

reach.description: per source node: items per galaxy system

touches.description: per source node: the summary hubs its videos and posts link to
